title: Server Attestation Document
description: An offline-signed clearance assertion published by an omcp tool server, as specified by SEP-2809. Served at /.well-known/mcp-attestation over TLS.

v.description: Document version. A verifier rejects versions it does not understand.

publisher.description: The entity that publishes the server.

clearance.description: Canonical name or alias of a level in a named, totally ordered classification scheme.

signerKeyId.description: Identifies a key in the host trust root. Absent only in an unsigned document, which a verifier denies.

signature.description: Base64 detached signature over the canonical body.

netAllowedHosts.description: When non-empty, binds the document to these origins. Part of the signed body when present.

verification.description: Free-form verification status, e.g. "tested". Part of the signed body when present.
